sections.heading: Features
paragraphs: Advanced car rental solution software
The Rental Agreement is the key part of the software which helps to collect and store all required information for car rental and also supports car replacement. Even with damage marking in and out.
You can directly get an invoice from the rental agreement page.
You can start tracking your report from the dashboard once the agreement is created.
It helps to keep track of the Maintenance history and Maintenance cost history of the vehicle.
If you want to transfer your car to another branch, you can use the branch transfer section. It will automatically update the branch of the car after the transfer is done.
If your car taken by staff or yourself and if it's non-revenue it can be entered into a Non Revenue Agreement
You can access every information from the dashboard ,vehicle count, branch wise count and many more ...
The app supports 20+ Master screens. You can enter common information in masters, and it can be selected in agreement. So you don't have to type everything again and again.
You can personalize the look and feel of the applications
We provide a database backup option to the customer. Customers can directly download backup from settings. It can be used to recover if something happens.

You Can generate 20+ reports from the application Fleet Related Reports, Agreement Reports, Revenue Reports, Vehicle Maintenance Reports, Non Revenue Reports, Booking Report. It helps to keep track of everything you need.
If you received a fine, no problem, you can search by vehicle number and fine date to find the customer details.

sections.heading: Features
paragraphs: Advanced Payroll software

The Payroll Application Administrator Module allows the admin to create and manage user accounts, configure payroll settings, and run monthly payroll calculations. Admins can also update company information and set up essential payroll details to ensure accurate and secure processing.

In the Masters Module, the admin can perform CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations on all lists of values, allowing full control over reference data such as Category, departments, and other essential configurations. This ensures that the system remains flexible and up-to-date with the latest information.

In the Transactions Module, the admin can perform tasks such as salary prerun, add allowances and deductions, update monthly salary information, and manage LWA (Leave Without Allowance) entries. This helps ensure accurate salary calculations and adjustments for employees on leave without allowances.

In the Transactions Module, the admin can also generate payroll reports and print them, providing a detailed overview of salary calculations, allowances, deductions, and leave adjustments. These reports ensure transparency and help in auditing and record-keeping of payroll information.

while dining in restaurants, we may have come across some situations where we would like to pay for another customer. The software allows you to combine those bills into one bill.

On some occasions, we may dine out with friends in a restaurant and since we are low on money, we will decide to split the bills so that everyone can pay for what they had. The software also provides the option to split a bill of a table.

In a growing restaurant/hotel, the menu of food items that they serve may change over time. So there is a need to customize the menu items when some new items are introduced or when some existing items are removed. The Software has the master screens that allows one user to edit the item details.
